GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-02-16T22:23:51Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: [QUESTION] How to filter by referenced collection primary key?
Description: Let's take next relation
```csharp
class Child
{
   int Id {get;set;}
}
class Owner
{
    int Id {get;set;}
    Child Child {get;set;}
}
```
Which is registered in next way
```csharp
Database.Mapper.Entity<Child>()
     .Id(e => e.Id, false);
Database.Mapper.Entity<Owner>()
     .DbRef(e => e.Child)
     .Id(e => e.Id, false);
```
On this point I understand, Owner document will contain only id of child document.
But how should I filter Owner documents by Child id?
I can use next code:
```csharp
Collection
    .Include(o => o.Child)
    .Find(Query.EQ($"{nameof(Owner.Child)}.{nameof(Child.Id)}", new BsonValue(idValue))))
```
But is it the best way to do filter by referenced document id? Because code above requires Include, when I don't really need child document, except of Id.
Also, how should I ensure index for it?

Thanks.
